column1: # The QoE regression gate's committed floors. QoeRegressionGateTest reads this file and never writes it.
# One row per NetworkProfile (superplayer-testkit), each the score that trace's session earned when its
# floor was set, beside the three terms the score is made of. Every figure is QoeScore's, in
# Mbps-equivalent per second played. The gate fails when a run scores more than its margin below a row.
# Moving a floor, up or down, is a decision: change the row in the commit that justifies it and put the
# reason in the last column. The gate prints the exact row to paste when a trace improves past the
# margin; it does not raise the floor itself. docs/testing.md, "The QoE regression gate", is the manual.
